S058.people: The father (full head of short strawberry-blond hair) between two young dark-haired women, one likely the mother
S058.event: Indoor house/dorm party, flash snapshot, arms around each other
S058.date_evidence: He still has a full head of hair (he is shaved/bald in all later frames) and looks about 20; flash-on-film party print with heavy red skin cast typical of mid-2000s point-and-shoot 4x6 prints
S058.notes: Very early college-age party frame; his pre-shaved-head hair is the anchor that puts this at the start of the whole archive. Blown-out flash and red cast, but the youth of all three faces is the value.

S059.people: Five young women and one young man in Santa hats, the dark-haired woman standing at right is likely the mother
S059.event: Christmas party piled on a bed/futon in a dorm or first apartment; Santa hats and a wreath on the door
S059.date_evidence: Dorm-room setting with taped-up photo prints on a bare wall, low-rise bootcut jeans and the very young faces; December (Santa hats, wreath)
S059.notes: College-era Christmas party in a dorm room, the sort of frame that no longer exists digitally. Soft focus and yellow tungsten cast.

S060.people: Three young women hugging on a bed, with a man's face partly visible behind them
S060.event: Dorm-room hangout, girls piled together laughing, box fan and red cup in frame
S060.date_evidence: Cinder-block dorm interior with box fan and red Solo cup; low-rise jeans and mid-2000s hair; same print stock and flash look as S059
S060.notes: Friends-only frame; the couple is not clearly together in it. Badly framed and tilted but genuine college-dorm texture.

S061.people: The father in a NY Yankees cap and white 'HOT DOG' t-shirt with the mother
S061.event: The two of them alone at a night-time party or bar, his arm around her
S061.date_evidence: He has hair under the cap and a very young, un-thickened face; she wears a thin chain and hoop-free simple jewelry; no rings visible on either hand
S061.notes: COUPLE ALONE, and one of the earliest frames of the two of them in the entire archive. Dark, noisy flash print, but the dating-years version of both faces is exactly what a 15th-anniversary film needs.

S062.people: The father in a navy ball cap and white tank with the mother in red athletic shorts
S062.event: The two of them at a marina, posed in front of a large white sportfishing boat, palm trees and a canal behind
S062.date_evidence: Print is scanned rotated 90 degrees; he has hair under the cap and a lean, teenage-looking build; her side-swept high ponytail and red side-stripe running shorts read early-to-mid 2000s
S062.notes: COUPLE ALONE on an early trip south; the scan is sideways but the print itself is sharp and well exposed. Their youngest faces of the whole batch.

S063.people: The father in a dark cap and swim trunks with the mother in a tank top
S063.event: Sitting together on a boat deck or sandbar with drinks, two yachts anchored in turquoise water behind them
S063.date_evidence: He is slim and still has hair under the cap; red plastic cups and no visible rings; saturated consumer film/print look with a white 4x6 border
S063.notes: COUPLE ALONE in the Caribbean/Bahamas on an early trip; genuinely beautiful light and water colour, one of the technically best prints in the batch.

S064.people: The father in a brown polo with the mother in a white tank
S064.event: Sitting on a low wall beside a bed of red flowers, arms around each other
S064.date_evidence: He still has hair; the print has been cropped to a wide panoramic strip, and both look early-20s; no rings visible
S064.notes: COUPLE ALONE, quiet and affectionate, but the print is a narrow letterboxed strip with heavy fade. Usable as a soft cutaway.

S065.people: The father in a Yankees pinstripe cap and jersey tee with the mother in a Yankees jersey
S065.event: Cheek-to-cheek at a Yankees game or a Fourth of July ballgame party
S065.date_evidence: Orange camera date stamp burned into the lower right of the print reads '07.04.2007' - i.e. 4 July 2007; matching Yankees gear on both
S065.notes: COUPLE ALONE with a readable burned-in date stamp of 07.04.2007 - one of the few hard-dated anchors in this batch. Very close crop, sun-flushed faces, matching team gear.

S066.people: The mother in a patterned halter dress and the father in a white dress shirt and black tie
S066.event: Dressed up together in a bar decorated with a lit Christmas tree, under a Rolling Rock beer sign
S066.date_evidence: Orange camera date stamp in the lower right reads '08.05.2007' (5 August 2007); Rolling Rock 'Extra Pale' sign behind them
S066.notes: COUPLE ALONE, hard-dated 08.05.2007 - note the lit Christmas tree in August, so this is a themed bar night, not a holiday. Severe orange/red flash cast on both faces.

S070.people: The mother in a white top with orange trim and the father in a dark polo
S070.event: Standing together at night at an outdoor bar or deck
S070.date_evidence: He still has his full strawberry-blond hair, so pre-dates the shaved-head frames; her long straight centre-parted hair and the flash-lit night bar setting
S070.notes: COUPLE ALONE on an ordinary night out - the everyday-dating material that is usually missing from an archive. Flat flash lighting, dark background.

S071.people: The mother in a black bikini top and the father with a shaved head, both shirtless/sunbathing
S071.event: Lying together on beach loungers under blue umbrellas at a resort beach
S071.date_evidence: Red drugstore-style stamp burned in at lower right reads a day and time ('28  12:45PM') with no year; his head is now shaved and his frame noticeably heavier/more adult than the hair-era frames
S071.notes: COUPLE ALONE on a beach holiday; the burned-in stamp gives only day 28 and 12:45PM, no year, so the date rests on his shaved head. Slightly blown highlights on the sand.

S073.people: The mother in a grey tank and the father with a shaved head and aviator sunglasses
S073.event: Arm's-length self-portrait in a resort courtyard with tiled roofs and palms behind
S073.date_evidence: Held-out-arm selfie framing (a habit that only becomes common with camera phones around 2010+); his head fully shaved and face much fuller than the 2007-dated frames
S073.notes: COUPLE ALONE, both genuinely laughing into the lens - the most spontaneous couple frame on sheet 4. Good light, slightly soft.

S075.people: The mother in a white top and grey skirt and the father in a white tee
S075.event: Posed together in front of an ornate dark carved wooden door, indoors at a restaurant or home
S075.date_evidence: He has a full head of hair and a very young face; her long straight hair with a thin white belt over a knee-length skirt reads mid-2000s; no rings visible
S075.notes: COUPLE ALONE, dressed up early in the relationship - possibly a dinner or an event they went to together. Warm indoor cast, decent sharpness.

S076.people: The father in a white tank and the mother in a pale tank top
S076.event: Sprawled together laughing in the back seat of a car
S076.date_evidence: He has hair and a lean build; boxy older car interior with manual window crank visible; heavy on-camera flash on film
S076.notes: COUPLE ALONE, completely unposed and laughing in a car back seat - very high emotional value. Faded, colour-shifted print with a blown-out flash.

S077.people: The mother wearing a 'Happy Birthday' tiara sitting on the father's lap
S077.event: Her birthday celebration on a deck at night, he in a striped dress shirt, she in a bright print tube top
S077.date_evidence: Plastic 'Happy Birthday' tiara identifies the occasion; he still has his full hair, dating it before the shaved-head era; denim mini over a bright tropical-print tube top is mid-2000s
S077.notes: COUPLE ALONE at one of her birthdays during the dating years - the tiara makes the occasion unambiguous. Night flash, heavy red cast on his face.

S078.people: The father in a green shirt with green beads, cap and sunglasses, and the mother in green; a third person in green at right
S078.event: St. Patrick's Day drinking at an outdoor bar deck, cars parked behind
S078.date_evidence: Everyone in green with plastic beads and plastic cups = St. Patrick's Day; his hair is very short/cropped, an intermediate stage between the hair frames and the fully shaved frames
S078.notes: One of several St. Patrick's Day frames in this batch (see S082, S086, S099) - together they read as an annual tradition. Daylight, reasonably exposed.

S079.people: No identifiable people; a small boat with figures far offshore
S079.event: Open ocean at dawn or dusk with a small boat on the horizon
S079.date_evidence: Nothing datable in frame - no people, no signage, no stamp; the pink/cyan fade is characteristic of an aged colour print but gives no year
S079.notes: Scenery only, from one of the boat/beach trips. Heavily faded to pink; usable only as an atmospheric cutaway.

S080.people: Two young women hanging out of a car or limo window; the mother is likely one of them
S080.event: Girls leaning out of a vehicle window at night, arms up, shouting and laughing
S080.date_evidence: Party-bus/limo night-flash frame with mid-2000s long straight hair; no phones or other tech visible to date it more tightly
S080.notes: Chaotic, motion-blurred and printed sideways, but full of energy. Friends-only, and I cannot confirm the mother is one of the two faces.

S081.people: The mother in a floral halter top and the father in a plain white tee with a very short crop
S081.event: Standing together at night outdoors, posed for the camera
S081.date_evidence: His hair is buzzed down close, in between the full-hair 2007 frames and the completely shaved later ones; both faces look a few years older than the 2007 date-stamped prints
S081.notes: COUPLE ALONE but a plain posed frame with harsh flash and a black background. Useful for showing the transition in his appearance.

S082.people: A large group of friends in green shirts and hats, the couple among them
S082.event: St. Patrick's Day crowd shot, beers raised, everyone in green
S082.date_evidence: Green shirts, shamrock gear and beer cans = St. Patrick's Day; the aluminium-bottle beers and the group's early-to-mid-20s ages suggest late 2000s
S082.notes: Big friend-group frame documenting the annual St. Patrick's Day outing. Busy and blurred, and the couple is hard to isolate in the crowd.

S083.people: The father with snow on his shaved head and the mother in a fur-trimmed hood
S083.event: The two of them outdoors in falling snow at night, cheek to cheek, string lights behind
S083.date_evidence: His head is shaved and his face is fuller than in the 2007-stamped prints; snow is actively falling and caught in the flash, and both wear heavy winter coats
S083.notes: COUPLE ALONE in a snowstorm, both laughing with snow visibly on his head - the most joyful frame on sheet 5. Flash-lit snowflakes cause hot spots but add to it.

S084.people: The father in an olive polo and sunglasses with the mother in a pink top and sunglasses; a third person's hand and phone in the foreground
S084.event: Posed together on the deck of a shore/beach house while someone else photographs them
S084.date_evidence: A silver clamshell flip phone is being held up in the foreground to take the same shot - flip phones place this roughly 2006-2010; his hair is buzzed very short
S084.notes: COUPLE ALONE at a beach house, with a period-accurate flip phone accidentally in frame - a strong incidental dating clue. Slight tilt and a foreground obstruction.

S085.people: Strangers on the beach - a woman in a bikini, a man and a toddler walking at the waterline
S085.event: Beach in front of a large pink resort with towers and a stone bridge
S085.date_evidence: The pink towered resort matches the Atlantis Paradise Island Royal Towers seen clearly in S110, so this belongs to the same Bahamas trip; nobody in frame is identifiable
S085.notes: Establishing shot of the resort from the same trip as S110; the people in it are not family. Useful only as scene-setting b-roll.

S086.people: The father in a red tee, sunglasses and a green 'GOT BEER?' novelty hat, with the mother in a green striped top and green beads
S086.event: St. Patrick's Day, the two of them squeezed together indoors in green gear
S086.date_evidence: Orange camera date stamp burned into the lower right reads '03.17.2007' - St. Patrick's Day 2007 - which matches the green hat and beads exactly
S086.notes: COUPLE ALONE, hard-dated by a burned-in stamp reading 03.17.2007 - the single cleanest date/occasion match in the batch. Very heavy red flash cast.

S087.people: No people - a wall covered in handwritten signatures
S087.event: A signed wall reading '409 TAYLOR' with dozens of names written on it, above a pool table or bar rail
S087.date_evidence: Orange camera date stamp reads '05.11.200-' (print is scanned upside down, last digit cut, consistent with the 2007 stamps elsewhere on this sheet); the mid-May date and the signed-wall ritual fit a college house move-out
S087.notes: '409 TAYLOR' signed by everyone who lived there - a record of a specific college address and the friends in it. Scanned upside down, low contrast, but the text is legible enough to read on screen.

S088.people: A dark-haired woman in a grey halter dress (likely the mother) laughing with a man in a white dress shirt; a girl seated at a table behind
S088.event: Dressed-up gathering in a large kitchen - people greeting and laughing before going out
S088.date_evidence: A red day/time stamp is burned into the lower right but only '7:35PM' is legible - no year; the man's dark hair means this is probably not the father, so I cannot use his appearance to date it
S088.notes: I could not confirm the man is the father - his hair colour does not match, so I am not asserting it. Warm natural light and a genuine laugh, but the identification is uncertain.

S089.people: The mother in a black strapless dress and the father in a waistcoat, white shirt and tie
S089.event: Dressed formally at an evening event - a wedding reception, gala or formal - both holding drinks
S089.date_evidence: Orange camera date stamp running up the left edge of the print reads '05.25.2007'; he still has his full hair, consistent with the other 2007 frames
S089.notes: COUPLE ALONE and dressed up, hard-dated 05.25.2007 by the burned-in stamp. Their most glamorous frame from the dating years; slight flash hotspot on his shirt.

S090.people: The father and mother on a couch, she in a black-and-white print dress
S090.event: Curled up together on a couch in an apartment with a flag or blanket pinned to the wall, beers in hand
S090.date_evidence: Orange camera date stamp in the lower right reads '05.27.2007' - two days after S089, so the same Memorial Day weekend
S090.notes: COUPLE ALONE in what looks like an early shared or friend's apartment, hard-dated 05.27.2007 and part of the same weekend as S089. Blown flash and a cluttered background.

S091.people: The father in a brown suit with a boutonniere and the mother in a pewter/silver beaded dress
S091.event: Standing on a brick sidewalk outside a wedding - he is wearing a groomsman's boutonniere, so this is someone else's wedding, not their own
S091.date_evidence: The boutonniere plus other guests in the background identify a wedding; there is no bride, dress or veil, so it is not theirs; his hair is present but thinning/short, placing it after the 2007 frames
S091.notes: COUPLE ALONE, formally dressed, at a wedding where he was in the wedding party - a natural 'before it was our turn' beat for the film. Slightly soft, good daylight.

S092.people: The father in a Titans #33 jersey and a long dreadlock wig, with the mother in a referee's striped shirt
S092.event: Halloween costume party outside a brick bar, red cup in hand
S092.date_evidence: Orange date stamp at lower right reads '10.27.20--' (day and month clear, year digits obscured) - the weekend before Halloween; costumes confirm the occasion
S092.notes: COUPLE ALONE in Halloween costumes; the burned-in stamp gives 10.27 but the year digits are unreadable at scan resolution. Funny, distinctive and well lit.

S093.people: The father in a black bandana and tank top with the mother, sunglasses pushed up on her head
S093.event: Close together on a boat or under a shelter on a hot day, both tanned and squinting
S093.date_evidence: His head is shaved under the bandana and his neck and shoulders are much heavier than in the 2007 frames; oversized sunglasses on her head fit the turn of the decade
S093.notes: COUPLE ALONE, very warm and relaxed with each other - one of the better later-era couple frames. Slightly soft and overexposed at the edges.

S094.people: The mother in a black one-shoulder top and sunglasses with the father in a dark tee
S094.event: A day out on the Philadelphia waterfront - the blue Benjamin Franklin Bridge and a moored tour boat are behind them, with a Captain Morgan bar umbrella
S094.date_evidence: Legible location: the Benjamin Franklin Bridge and Penn's Landing riverfront in Philadelphia; his head is shaved and his build is heavier, placing it in the later group
S094.theme: Adventure; Young love; The life we built
S094.notes: COUPLE ALONE with an identifiable city landmark behind them, which makes it useful for grounding the film geographically. Good daylight exposure.

S095.people: The father in an academic gown and hood with the mother in a black dress
S095.event: His graduation - a banner above them reads 'CONGRATULATIONS, GRADUATES' beneath a large ornamental clock, with balloon arches in the background
S095.date_evidence: The legible 'CONGRATULATIONS, GRADUATES' banner and his gown with an academic hood identify a commencement; his hair is short and receding, past the 2007-stamped frames but before the fully shaved era
S095.notes: COUPLE ALONE at his graduation with the ceremony banner readable in frame - the single biggest documented milestone in this batch. Black-and-white print, scanned upside down, but sharp and beautifully composed.

S096.people: The father in sunglasses holding the mother in a crowded resort pool
S096.event: The two of them together in a busy resort or cruise-ship pool, other guests on loungers behind
S096.date_evidence: His head is shaved and he is visibly heavier-built than in the hair-era frames; wraparound mirrored sunglasses; no stamp or signage to narrow it
S096.notes: COUPLE ALONE but tiny in a badly composed frame - they occupy only the right quarter and the print is scanned upside down. Sweet moment, weak photograph.

S097.people: The mother in a white lace dress and the father in a black shirt
S097.event: Night out on a casino floor - illuminated slot machines and a neon restaurant sign behind them
S097.date_evidence: Casino slot-machine floor with neon signage identifies the venue (Las Vegas or Atlantic City); his hair is buzzed extremely short, between the 2007 hair frames and the fully shaved ones
S097.notes: COUPLE ALONE on a casino trip; her white dress is worth flagging as it could be a bachelorette-weekend frame, though nothing in the image proves that. Mixed neon colour cast.

S098.people: The father in a black suit and tie with the mother in a deep purple strapless gown
S098.event: Seated together at a formal reception - other guests in suits visible behind
S098.date_evidence: Both in formalwear at a reception, but no bride, veil or head table is visible so I cannot call it their wedding; his hair is buzzed very short, matching the late-2000s group
S098.notes: COUPLE ALONE and the most flattering formal portrait of the two of them in the batch. It is a wedding reception, but the evidence does not tell me whose.

S099.people: A large group of friends in green shirts and shamrock gear, beers raised
S099.event: St. Patrick's Day gathering in a brick beer garden, a banner strung on the fence behind
S099.date_evidence: Green shamrock shirts, headbands and beer cans = St. Patrick's Day; the group looks slightly older than the S082 crowd, so probably a later year of the same tradition
S099.notes: Another year of the annual St. Patrick's Day outing with the same friend group. The couple is not clearly identifiable in the crush.

S100.people: The mother in a black slip dress and the father in a white striped shirt, shaved head
S100.event: Posed together on a restaurant patio or courtyard in the evening, drink in his hand
S100.date_evidence: His head is completely shaved and his build is at its heaviest/most muscular of any frame; her hair is pulled back with a longer, more adult styling than the college frames
S100.theme: Young love; Growing together; The life we built
S100.notes: COUPLE ALONE, both looking straight at the camera and genuinely happy - the cleanest, best-exposed couple portrait in the whole batch.

S101.people: The father in sunglasses and the mother, both in the sea
S101.event: The two of them swimming together in clear turquoise ocean, heads and shoulders above water
S101.date_evidence: Shaved head and heavier adult build; deeply tanned; the same clear Caribbean water and trip look as S110 and S103
S101.notes: COUPLE ALONE in the ocean, both laughing - gorgeous water colour and one of the most joyful, filmic frames here. Strong hero candidate.

S102.people: The mother reaching across a restaurant table, an older bald man holding an infant and feeding it a bottle, other diners around
S102.event: Family dinner at a restaurant, someone holding and bottle-feeding a baby at the table
S102.date_evidence: Red day/time stamp at lower right reads '28  7:35PM' with no year; the very next print S103 is stamped '29  5:59PM', so the two are consecutive days on the same trip; the baby is not one of theirs given the pre-2013 scope of this folder
S102.notes: Extended-family dinner on a trip; the infant is somebody else's child - I am not assuming a relationship. The burned-in stamp gives only day 28 and 7:35PM.

S103.people: The mother and the father in sunglasses, at the edge of a resort pool
S103.event: Leaning on the pool edge together in the late afternoon, towels spread on the deck
S103.date_evidence: Red day/time stamp reads '29  5:59PM' with no year, one day after S102's '28  7:35PM' - same trip; his shaved head and heavier build put the trip in the later group
S103.notes: COUPLE ALONE at the pool on the same holiday as S102 (stamps 28 and 29 on consecutive days). Nicely lit late-afternoon colour, no year in the stamp.

S104.people: The father alone, crouched and working, shirtless in the sun
S104.event: Sanding or refinishing cabinets and drawer boxes outdoors in a driveway, a visible cloud of dust, a bicycle leaning behind him
S104.date_evidence: His head is shaved and his build is heavy and muscular, matching the later group; the work itself - refinishing kitchen cabinetry in a driveway - suggests fixing up a house they had just bought
S104.theme: Home; The life we built; Everyday life
S104.notes: Almost certainly a first-home renovation - the dust cloud caught mid-air makes it visually striking. Badly framed with him small and off-centre, but the story value is high.

S105.people: A crowd of unidentified holidaymakers walking away down a resort street
S105.event: Walking back from the beach along a palm-lined resort road, one couple with arms around each other in the middle distance
S105.date_evidence: Same resort setting and print stock as the other later vacation frames; no faces identifiable and no signage or stamp to date it
S105.notes: Scene-setting frame from a holiday; I cannot confirm the couple is in it. Useful only as b-roll.

S106.people: The father in a grey suit, the mother in a black satin bridesmaid dress with a bouquet, a second bridesmaid in the same dress, and another man in a grey suit and gold tie
S106.event: Someone else's wedding - the mother is a bridesmaid, holding a matching white bouquet in a matching dress, posed outdoors with another couple
S106.date_evidence: Two identical black satin bridesmaid dresses and matching white bouquets identify a wedding party, but there is no bride, veil or groom's boutonniere on him, so it is not their wedding; his head is shaved, placing it in the later group
S106.notes: She is a bridesmaid at another couple's wedding, with him as her date - a good 'in the wedding years' beat. Well exposed daylight and everybody sharp.

S107.event: A decorated and lit Christmas tree with a red skirt in the corner of a living room
S107.date_evidence: Flat-panel wall-mounted television visible at upper right (wall-mounted flat panels in a home point to roughly 2009 onward); no people, no stamp
S107.theme: Home; Holidays; The life we built
S107.notes: Likely their first Christmas tree in their own home, which is why I am not filing it as pure archive. Green/yellow colour shift and no people in frame.

S108.event: Exterior of a two-storey house - beige siding, white-trimmed double-hung windows, a pillared portico and a new-looking carved wooden front door with leaded glass
S108.date_evidence: Newly built or newly finished construction with no landscaping yet around the entry; taking a photograph of a house exterior on print film is the classic 'we bought it' frame; no stamp or people to date it precisely
S108.theme: Home; The life we built; Milestones
S108.notes: Almost certainly their first house - flagged as meaningful rather than archived despite having no people in it. Scanned rotated and heavily washed out/hazy.

S109.people: The mother alone at the wheel of a golf cart
S109.event: Driving a red golf cart on a course cut through pine woods, waving at the camera
S109.date_evidence: The cart is a Yamaha 'Drive' model (the tuning-fork logo on the cowl), a body style introduced around 2007, so this is 2007 or later; bare deciduous scrub and pines indicate a winter or early-spring golf trip south
S109.notes: Solo frame of her enjoying a golf trip - useful for showing her on her own rather than always as half of a couple. Windscreen reflections obscure part of her face.

S110.people: The mother in a black one-piece swimsuit and the father in a straw fedora, sunglasses and blue board shorts
S110.event: Standing together in shallow turquoise water with the Atlantis Paradise Island Royal Towers directly behind them - the Bahamas
S110.date_evidence: The distinctive pink Royal Towers of Atlantis, Paradise Island are unmistakable in the background, identifying the location; his fully shaved head, heavy muscular build and the straw trilby place it at the very end of this archive - a strong honeymoon candidate given they married around 2011
S110.theme: Vacations; Marriage; Adventure; The life we built
S110.notes: COUPLE ALONE at Atlantis in the Bahamas, with the resort clearly identifiable - very likely the honeymoon, though nothing in the frame proves it outright. Sharp, bright and the best-looking print of the later era.
